## Invariant sweeps

Sites checked: **0 / 32**. A site is `checked` on the same evidence a scenario is PASS on — a committed, non-skipped test carrying its `@inv:` tag that a project config runs.

| Invariant | Statement | Sites checked |
|---|---|---|
| **INV1** | No irreversible write is ordered ahead of a step that can fail. | 0/8 |
| **INV2** | Conservation — nothing the user holds vanishes without being carried, or explicitly warned about. | 0/5 |
| **INV3** | Totality — every input lands in exactly one visible bucket. No silent nulls, and every declared reason is producible. | 0/5 |
| **INV4** | No confident negative without an on-chain cross-check. | 0/8 |
| **INV5** | Every affordance offered is executable by the connected wallet, checked before it is offered. | 0/6 |
